description: Static source index and offline local query demo, not a real-time national feed or a DNS replacement.

records.title: Weimar civilians visit liberated Buchenwald
records.claim: Museum archive describes US soldiers escorting German civilians from Weimar through the liberated Buchenwald camp in April 1945.
records.not_a_claim: No inference about the knowledge or guilt of every German civilian.

records.title: CIA established September 18, 1947
records.claim: CIA was established effective September 18, 1947; OSS is a predecessor organization.
records.not_a_claim: The CIA was not an agency operating during World War II.

records.title: Office of Strategic Services timeline
records.claim: National Archives tracks the OSS and its postwar transitions; its timeline records OSS ending in September 1945.
records.not_a_claim: Do not assign OSS actions to the CIA without institutional and date-specific evidence.

records.title: Watch historical films via Library of Congress
records.claim: The Library provides selected historical films for viewing, but rights prevent the Library from posting every National Film Registry film.
records.not_a_claim: Library film access is not universal copyright permission.

records.title: Make an emergency preparedness plan
records.claim: Ready.gov is an official source for general emergency preparedness resources.
records.not_a_claim: Not an operational warning or a replacement for local emergency alerts.

records.title: Coinbase full-history audit controls
records.claim: Public audit membrane requires complete bounded history and stable-ID reconciliation before claiming coverage.
records.not_a_claim: Does not prove any actual personal trade, cause, cost basis, or balance.

daily_public_brief.policy: An actual dated brief must bind every claim to date-scoped sources and digest receipts, disclose content-time versus retrieval-time, preserve conflicts and coverage gaps, and pass privacy and human release review.
daily_public_brief.privacy: No personal watch history, financial balances, demographics, or film reflections.

dns_note: This interface provides source discovery and organization. DNS resolves domain names; it is not replaced.
firewall_note: Privacy boundaries and opt-in authorization; no assertion of a new US national firewall or citizenship requirement.
identity_note: Independent learning project; not US government or agency endorsed.
